acts.title: Network opens
acts.story: v2.1 contracts wired (bond and verdict log authorize the payment contracts), operator posts an 8 USDC bond, products 1-4 proposed and activated.

acts.title: First paid work
acts.story: enclaves registered through DCAP; 3 x402 calls settled; session #1 opened (1 USDC), bounty #1 posted, exploit replayed in TDX, claim accepted, report delivered, hunter paid 0.5 USDC + verdict 100; session settled 0.0994 USDC; one browser x402 call; session closed, 0.9006 refunded, verdict 100.

acts.title: A lying enclave is caught
acts.story: three demo operators bond 1 USDC each, product 5 and bounty #2 created, the lying enclave's doubled-loss claim is accepted, two honest replays refute it: bond slashed 1 USDC, verdict 0, demo enclaves retired/invalidated.

acts.title: Verified level
acts.story: verified-level settlement proposed (8-day delay), products 1/3/4 updated, enclaves re-registered on new images, one x402 call, machine declared by the Proof of Cloud alliance (token verified on-chain).

acts.title: Product 7
acts.story: product 7 (verified-level Sealed Bounty) created, its level policy applied, a 1 USDC bounty funded on the verified contract (not in the read API).

acts.title: Steady state: renewals
acts.story: only registration renewals: each live enclave re-attests about every 12 h (EnclaveRegistered + EnclaveImage + MachineBound).
